elements.title: PYTHON CODE
elements.details: Screenshot of Python code showing how to use sklearn.utils resample to perform bootstrapping on data with columns 'BARTHAG' and 'W'. The code plots a scatter plot of 'BARTHAG' vs 'W', then resamples 100 points 50 times, fits a model, collects slopes and intercepts, and plots predicted lines in red.
elements.summary: This code snippet demonstrates bootstrapping by resampling data multiple times, fitting a model each time, and plotting the resulting regression lines to visualize variability in slopes and intercepts.
